name: Kangoku no Alchemist ~Ryoujoku to Injuu Chimera no Kyouen~
original_name: 姦獄のアルケミスト ～陵辱と淫獣キメラの狂宴～
source:
In this world, alchemy exists as today's skill.
Redon Empire tries to cast alchemy on its army to take over the world.
The empire built a research center to create Chimera with alchemy.
Alto, who broke the military rule and was sent to the research center to be an experiment sample.
However, he was saved by Elisa, who was a young head of the center.
Then, he joins the team of alchemist and help the Chimera project with Fururu and Hilde.
It was beyond imagination...

People's scream echoes in the dark forest. Women falling with pleasure.
What awaits them after the end of experiment?
